title: Swiftly Variables
description: Swiftly group: Swift toolchain provisioning parameters. Variable names are camelCase and prefixed with the group token 'swiftly'.

swiftlyOperations.description: Ordered, non-empty list of Swiftly operations to run. The currently supported operation is install; supply it at ansible-playbook runtime with -e.

swiftlySwiftVersion.description: Pinned Swift toolchain version Swiftly installs and selects (swiftly install --use). Accepts a full version (6.3.3) or a minor version (6.3). Role default in roles/swiftly/defaults/main.yml; override per host/group in a downstream inventory or with -e swiftlySwiftVersion=....
